table.retrieve:
SELECT I.name,
		 itemalias=I.customicode,
		 OH.POCode, 
	    OH.Date,
       Acc.name,
		 S.address1,
		 S.address2,  
		 S.city,
		 S.phone,
		 S.fax,
		 S.specialinstructions,
		 OH.remarks,
		 OH.purorderterms1,
		 OH.purorderterms2,
		 OH.purorderterms3,
		 OH.purorderterms4,
		 OH.purorderterms5,
		 OH.purorderterms6,
		 OH.purorderterms7,
		 OH.purorderterms8,
		 OH.demanddraftno,
		 invdiscperc=OH.discperc,
		 OH.dated,
		 orderamount = OH.amount ,
		 customer = ( Select name From Accounts Where ACCcode = OH.custcode ) , 
		 custaddress1 = ( Select address1 From Customer Where Custcode = OH.custcode ) , 
		 custcity = ( Select city From Customer Where custcode = OH.custcode ) , 
		 I.packingdesc,
       OD.rate,
       OD.qty,
		 OD.bonusqty,
		 OD.discperc,
		invgstperc1=OH.invgstperc1,
		invflatdisc=OH.flatdisc,
		misccharges=OH.misccharges,
       amount= (OD.qty * OD.rate) * ( 1 - (od.discperc * 0.01) ) 


FROM item I, accounts Acc, purorderheader OH, purorderdetail OD , Supplier S 

WHERE OH.pocode >= :ai_sPOCode AND
		OH.pocode <= :ai_lPOCode AND
      OH.pocode = OD.pocode AND
		OH.suppCode = S.SuppCode AND
      OH.suppcode = Acc.acccode AND
      OD.icode = I.icode

order by oh.pocode, i.name

objects.name: c_netamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(amount for group 1)* (1 - invdiscperc*0.01) - invflatdisc + misccharges ,0 )+Round(((c_totalamount * (1 -  invdiscperc *0.01)) - invflatdisc)* invgstperc1*0.01,0)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: sum( amount for group 1 ) - Round (sum( amount for group 1 ) * ( invdiscperc * 0.01)  , 2 )
